pages.title: Sunday power-up: Sanctuary
pages.summary: Bring the sanctuary AVL system up for a service (about 10 minutes). Amps last on, first off.
pages.body:
Follow the steps in order for the [[room:sanc]].

> [!WARNING]
> Never power the amps while the console is still booting.

## 1. Power and network

- [ ] Switch on [[device:sanc-pdu-foh]] (master switch on the rear of the FOH rack).
- [ ] Switch on [[device:sanc-pdu-amp]] in the amp room.
- [ ] Wait until the link lights on [[device:sanc-sw-foh]] and [[device:sanc-sw-stage]] are green.

## 2. Audio

- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-stagebox]] — the Dante sync LED goes solid green.
- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-console]] and recall the scene `SUNDAY AM`.
- [ ] Check the master fader is at **-inf**.
- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-dsp]], then [[device:sanc-amp-main]] and [[device:sanc-amp-fill]].
- [ ] Switch on the four receivers [[device:sanc-wrx-1]] … [[device:sanc-wrx-4]] and check RF on each handheld.

## 3. Video

- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-switcher]]; select input **3 (Lyrics)**.
- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-proj-l]] and [[device:sanc-proj-r]] with the remote and wait for warm-up.
- [ ] Confirm lyrics appear on [[device:sanc-confidence]].

## 4. Lighting

- [ ] Power on [[device:sanc-lx-console]] and load the show `Sunday`.
- [ ] Run cue **1 – House full**.

## Done

Play a track from [[device:sanc-playback]] at a low level and walk the room.
